description: Recommend the best local-LLM model + config for given hardware and tasks, from real tracked benchmarks. Returns ranked picks with measured tok/s and a source link. Never invents numbers. config.speculative=true means the tok/s came from speculative decoding (MTP, DFlash, a draft model), not a plain run of the same quant; say so when quoting it. AI boxes (unified memory, up to 128 GB+) and GPU cards (own VRAM) are separate lanes: `lane` says which one the picks came from; never present a card pick and a box pick as one ranking.

cards.description: true: read the GPU-card lane (RTX 5090, RTX PRO 6000) instead of the AI boxes. Naming a card as hardware does the same. The two lanes are never ranked together.

tasks.description: what the user wants to do

name: tokenmark_recommend
